secondToolValidation.justification: Fresh-session independent audit of the sealed SETUP-00-CP-0012. The tool, the provider and the model are the implementing run's, so this is session independence and not cross-tool validation, and it is not recorded as one: the attestation records crossToolValidation NOT_AVAILABLE and the derivation refuses MILESTONE_EXTERNAL_PASS from it.

independentReview.tool: Claude Code 2.1.195, fresh session, Anthropic, claude-opus-5
independentReview.justification: CP11-F-001 is CLOSED, proved by executing m0_mirror_audit.py over six applicability states in disposable clones rather than by reading the delivery's artifacts. The expected requirement set, the evidence resolution, the derived counts, the guardrail measurement and the integrity chain were all re-derived with this audit's own readers and agreed exactly. No new finding.

redTeam.tool: the adversarial battery of this audit, independent of m0_red_team.py
redTeam.justification: Twenty-six scenarios executed against disposable clones of the sealed subject, one clone per scenario, over two null-mutation controls that were accepted first. None escaped. Six scenarios target the state the CP11-F-001 repair opened, and three repair their own tracks by re-deriving the declared inventory hashes so the refusal is attributable to the control under test.
